summary: Enterprise AI model API aggregators let corporations consume foundation models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral and more) through a managed, secure API that keeps data inside their existing cloud trust boundary. As of 2026 the market is led by the three hyperscaler platforms — AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/Foundry, and Google Vertex AI — with data-platform entrants (Snowflake Cortex, Databricks) and governance-focused players (IBM watsonx) gaining ground. There is no single winner; the best fit is driven by a company's existing cloud footprint, required model diversity, and compliance posture.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: prompts, completions and fine-tuning data stay within the company's cloud tenant/VPC and chosen region, rather than being sent to a third-party vendor's API.

Compliance and governance: aggregators inherit the hyperscaler's certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR, EU data boundary) and add audit logging, IAM, and policy controls out of the box.
Consolidated billing and existing contracts: usage rolls into the enterprise's existing cloud commit/EDP, simplifying procurement, cost allocation, and vendor management.
Model choice behind one API: a single integration provides access to multiple vendors' models (Claude, Llama, Mistral, Gemini, GPT), enabling easy switching and avoiding single-vendor lock-in.
Enterprise integration and security: native tie-in to cloud identity, networking (private endpoints/VPC), KMS encryption, RBAC, and surrounding data/analytics services.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service (Azure AI Foundry)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per 1K/1M tokens by model, plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved, predictable capacity.
key_features: VNet/private endpoints and no data used to train base models
Entra ID (Azure AD) RBAC and managed identities
Azure Monitor diagnostic/audit logs
Fine-tuning and distillation support
Content safety filters and responsible AI tooling
Deep integration with Microsoft 365 / Copilot ecosystem
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-first enterprises needing OpenAI's frontier GPT models with strong governance and M365 integration.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token on-demand, Batch (discounted), and Provisioned Throughput (reserved model units) for guaranteed capacity.
key_features: 30+ foundation models behind one API with easy model switching
PrivateLink/VPC access, data not used to train base models
IAM-based identity and fine-grained access control
CloudTrail / CloudWatch audit logging
Fine-tuning and custom model import
Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases (RAG), and Guardrails
platforms.best_for: AWS-centric enterprises wanting the widest multi-vendor model choice (especially Claude) under one secure API.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (Model Garden)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per token/character, plus Generative AI Scale Units (GSUs) for provisioned throughput (e.g., ~25 GSUs of Gemini 2.5 Flash ≈ 67,250 tokens/sec sustained).
key_features: VPC Service Controls and private access
Model Garden multi-vendor catalog incl. Claude and Llama
Cloud IAM and Cloud Audit Logs
Supervised and RLHF fine-tuning, distillation
Grounding with Google Search and enterprise data (RAG)
Integration with BigQuery and the Google data stack
platforms.best_for: Google Cloud / BigQuery-centric organizations wanting Gemini plus a multimodal and data-grounded AI stack.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Snowflake credits, billed by tokens processed per model function.
key_features: LLMs run inside the Snowflake data perimeter — data never leaves governance boundary
SQL and Python (Cortex functions) access to models
Role-based access control and row/column governance inherited from Snowflake
Query/access audit logging
Cortex Analyst, Search, and Document AI for RAG over governed data
Fine-tuning of select open models
platforms.best_for: Enterprises whose data already lives in Snowflake wanting AI directly on governed data without movement.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI (Foundation Model APIs)
platforms.pricing: DBU consumption-based pricing; pay-per-token for served models plus provisioned throughput options.
key_features: Unity Catalog governance and lineage over models and data
Model Serving with private networking
AI Gateway for unified access and rate limiting across external models
Fine-tuning and RAG on lakehouse data
Audit logging via Unity Catalog / system tables
MLflow for lifecycle management
platforms.best_for: Data-engineering and ML teams on the lakehouse wanting to build and govern custom GenAI apps on their data.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Resource Unit (RU) / token-based consumption pricing; available on IBM Cloud, on-prem, and hybrid via Cloud Pak for Data.
key_features: On-prem and hybrid deployment for strict sovereignty
watsonx.governance for model risk, bias, and compliance monitoring
IP indemnification on IBM Granite models
watsonx Orchestrate for multi-platform agent management
Audit, lineage, and factsheets
Fine-tuning and prompt tuning
platforms.best_for: Regulated industries and hybrid/on-prem enterprises prioritizing governance, sovereignty, and auditability.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-character/token on-demand, plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved hosting capacity.
key_features: Dedicated AI clusters for isolated, private model hosting
OCI IAM identity and private VCN access
Audit logging via OCI Audit service
Fine-tuning (T-Few / custom) on dedicated clusters
Sovereign and dedicated region options
Integration with Oracle Fusion/ERP applications
platforms.best_for: Oracle database and Fusion Applications customers needing GenAI within OCI's sovereign/dedicated infrastructure.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Usage-based 'Neurons' metric billed per inference; generous free tier, no GPU provisioning required.
key_features: Serverless inference at the edge in 300+ cities (low latency)
AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting, and observability across providers
Data localization / regional compliance controls
Request logging and analytics
Vectorize vector DB and R2 integration for RAG
Pay-per-use with no cluster management
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency, globally distributed edge inference and a unified AI gateway.
